name: content-refresh
description: Audit → approve → refresh. Finds decayed content with SE Ranking data, diagnoses why each page dropped, and generates surgical, fact-checked update drafts after in-chat approval. Two skills: refresh-audit and refresh-update.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose content decay, approve, get refreshed drafts
interface.longDescription: A two-skill flow for refreshing existing content. refresh-audit finds decayed pages (or takes your URLs), scrapes them, diagnoses why each one dropped — staleness, competitor gaps, intent shift, lost SERP features, AI-visibility loss, cannibalization — and proposes the lightest update depth that fixes it, with preservation locks on everything that still works. You approve in chat; refresh-update then writes each refreshed article as a fact-checked markdown draft. It never publishes anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Audit my content — find the decayed pages on mydomain.com and tell me why they dropped.
Audit these URLs and propose the lightest refresh for each.
Go ahead with the approved updates and generate the drafts.
